name: Launch Canada 2027: DTEG Revision 4 + LC 2027 DTEG and R&R Edicts (to become DTEG R5)
note: Thresholds from DTEG R4 and the LC 2027 edicts. Edicts take precedence where they differ; final R5 wording may change but the rules and intent will not (edicts preamble). Always verify against the current official documents.

stability.diameterChangeNote: With transitions between airframe diameters, use RASAero CP/CD overrides and keep margin above 2 cal.

chuteReleaseLimits.ref: R4.1.1 (Jolly Logic Chute Release not permitted beyond these)

staticMarginPercentLength.window: rail exit to twice the burn duration of each stage
staticMarginPercentLength.ref: 2027 Edicts, Stability: Static Margin (10% of body length)

manualChecks: Altimeter bays of any stage above Mach 0.7: concentric bay with concentric air sampling holes; crescent bays only in RF-transparent material.
No more than one altimeter per circuit; no custom circuitry/software to arm a COTS altimeter; SRAD PCBs with COTS altimeters only to simplify one board's wiring.
Hardware shunts on sustainer ignition circuits.
Physical switch for all electronics; wireless switches in series with a physical switch reachable (ladder rules: 3 points of contact, secured shoes).
Lithium batteries: vinyl or shrink wrap for fire/puncture protection, padded cells, never zip-tied to a plank.
Individual power supply for each deployment altimeter and each GPS/RF beacon; plan on-rail/external charging.
Radax joints mechanically pinned AND chemically bonded.
Recessed nozzles clear a 45 degree expansion fan without touching the airframe.
3D-printed parts: holes modelled in CAD (no drilling into infill / heat-set inserts in infill); multiple walls, gyroid/cubic infill.
Rail buttons machined from Delrin (POM); no metal rail buttons.
Assembly dress rehearsal with the finished rocket: pop test every separating bay (drogue, main, every stage); yank test for single-bay dual deploy.

Radio: at most 2 allocations per stage across 220/440/915 MHz; one 220 MHz beacon per stage (25 kHz); one 440 MHz per stage (125 kHz); 915 MHz: one per project, or up to 2 Featherweight Swift / BRB900L per stage; 2.4/5.8 GHz narrow (10 MHz) directional links.
SRAD engines: two full-duration tests bounding the operating pressure; hydrotest -> 20 valve actuations at MEOP -> abort test -> cold flow -> hot fire.
Operations: rocket on the rail before yellow flag; red flag 10 min before salvo; >25 min past salvo start = timeout.
